summary: Switched UsageMeter to use transform:scaleX instead of animating width, and darkened the Workbench Ember accent token from #d54f35 to #c43f26 in DESIGN.md (documented as clearing 4.5:1 contrast on raised surfaces). Then audited remaining references to the old accent hex, made several shell/session polish edits (titlebar workspace fact color, session-running aria-label, thread delete dialog with targetMessageCount), and began investigating inline tool-error rendering in ToolCallCard/ToolResult.
decisions: UsageMeter fill uses transform:scaleX with a 0–1 fraction instead of width:% animation
Accent color value changed from #d54f35 to #c43f26 to achieve 4.5:1 contrast on raised surfaces for normal-size text
SessionSidebar session-running indicator gets aria-label='Agent working' for screen readers
Thread delete confirm dialog now shows the target session's messageCount alongside the title for a concrete confirmation (implemented via new targetMessageCount getter on session-actions)
errors: First edit attempt on SessionSidebar.svelte failed with 'Could not find the exact text' because of whitespace/indentation mismatch; succeeded on retry after reading the exact surrounding lines.
